errors.evidence: The intervals between the labeled years on the x-axis (2008, 2012/2013, 2017, 2021) are not uniform, nor are they one year apart.

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос за графика Б е обозначена като "Структурен ефект върху средния леглоден (%)"
errors.evidence: The y-axis label for graph B is "Структурен ефект върху средни леглодни (%)" (plural "леглодни"), not "средния леглоден" (singular).
The labeled range on the y-axis for graph B is from 1.0 to 2.0. Stating the range starts at 0.0% is an incorrect assumption, as the axis is not fully shown.
Graph A's line clearly has black circular markers at each data point.
The starting value in graph A for the year 2008 is approximately 278, which is significantly higher than the reported 273.

errors.text_span: В графиката може да се забележи увеличаване на стойността до около 267 единици през 2012/2013 година, след което следва спад.
errors.evidence: This misrepresents the trend in graph A. The line first decreases from ~278 (2008) to ~266 (around 2012), then increases to a local peak of ~270 (around 2013), before decreasing again. The description states a single increase to a wrong value.
Graph B's line clearly has black circular markers at each data point.
In graph B, the line does not reach 0.0%. It reaches a minimum of approximately 0.8% around 2013.
The final value in graph B for the year 2021 is clearly above the 2.0% tick mark, at approximately 2.15%. The reported value of 1.8% is a significant underestimate.
The description fails to mention that both plots A and B contain five distinct data points, even though there are only four labels on the x-axis. This is a key structural feature of the plots.
